selection: Choose one model/profile before acceptance, using semantic C correctness first, then A/B semantic correctness, then format; constrained decoding is a separate format comparison. No prompt retuning or hidden retries.
qualification: At least 11/12 correct content in each A/B/C task on acceptance; zero false contradictions for correct/unknown claims and zero false approvals of contradicted claims. A/B must show content not merely formatting. Otherwise do not reintegrate.
